Turf Laying in the Blue Mountains

Fresh lawn turf supplied and laid on graded, prepared soil — a lush, even, hard-wearing lawn made for Mountains conditions.

A good lawn up here comes down to two things: the right turf and proper preparation. We choose a turf variety suited to your block’s sun, shade and traffic, then lay it on graded, weed-free soil so it establishes fast and evenly.

From a small front lawn to a full backyard, we handle removing the old lawn, soil prep and levelling, laying, and the first care instructions so your new lawn takes off.

What’s included

  • Supply and lay quality lawn turf
  • Turf variety matched to sun and shade
  • Old lawn removal and soil preparation
  • Grading and levelling
  • Clean, even edges and joins
  • Watering and care advice
